main_measure.name: t of the slope of 72-bar excess return on forecast (mean_reversion grid bars)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 with supporting check passed; reject if t <= -2

supporting_check.name: slope of 24-to-72-bar excess return on forecast, > 0 and >= half the main slope

decided_by: Main slope t >= 2 but the supporting check fails.
reading: Grid bars are positions 0, 72, 144... of each window with close[t+72] inside it, the regime is the recorded `regime` at the grid bar, and each excess (72-bar and 24-to-72-bar) is over that coin's mean of the same grid return across all its grid bars in all windows.
